name: How to Check and Convert a PDF to PDF/A-2b or PDF/A-2u
description: Check whether a PDF meets PDF/A archival requirements and convert eligible files — free, no upload required.

step.name: Open your PDF
step.text: Click 'Choose files' or drag your PDF into the drop zone. The file is analyzed entirely in your browser.

step.name: Review the compliance report
step.text: PDFree checks embedded fonts, encryption, an already-applied digital signature, interactive actions/JavaScript at the document, page, and annotation level, LZW-compressed streams, and Unicode text mapping.

step.name: Convert if compliant
step.text: If no blocking issues are found, click 'Convert' to add the required ICC color profile, XMP metadata, and file identifier, automatically remove any interactive actions found, and download the converted file — PDF/A-2u when your fonts support it, PDF/A-2b otherwise.
